Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

AAGISurvey 2.0.1

Bug fix

  • Add missing Import for {withr}.

AAGISurvey 2.0.0

Breaking changes

  • build_url() now takes base as its last argument, and it is optional. Code that passed base as the first positional argument must now name it (base = "https://...") or move it to the end.

New features

  • New exported function survey_base_url() returns the base URL of the AAGI Qualtrics survey. The URL is now defined in one place (SURVEY_BASE_URL in constants.R), so dependent packages and apps, such as the Shiny app, can use it instead of hard coding their own copy.

  • build_url() uses survey_base_url() as the default for base. create_survey_url() no longer hard codes the URL.

Bug fixes

  • create_survey_url() now prints the “Support type” line in its summary. It was never shown before.

  • create_survey_url() now shows <blank> in the summary for a design or analysis type that doesn’t apply. It previously showed nothing.

  • create_survey_url() now stops with “You must select a support type” if the support type menu is cancelled. Previously it carried on without a support type.

Minor improvements and internal changes

  • create_survey_url() was split into smaller internal helpers (resolve_support_type(), prompt_if_missing(), label_for() and print_survey_summary()) to reduce its cyclomatic complexity. Its behaviour is unchanged apart from the fixes above.

  • Added an internal select_one() wrapper around utils::select.list() so the interactive menu can be mocked in tests.

  • Expanded test coverage for build_url(), create_survey_url(), copy_to_clip() and survey_base_url(). The clipboard is now mocked, so tests no longer skip when no clipboard is available.

AAGISurvey 1.0.1

  • Provide new URL for survey, necessary since the survey was moved from Rose’s Curtin Qualtrics to Adam’s Curtin Qualtrics account.

AAGISurvey 1.0.0

Minor changes

  • Updates text prompts for clarity.

Breaking changes

  • Users can no longer select more than one service type.

Bug fixes

  • Replace more instances of UA/University of Adelaide with AU/Adelaide University.

AAGISurvey 0.0.3

Minor changes

AAGISurvey 0.0.2

AAGISurvey 0.0.1

  • Initial release.
